title: Weighted 14-Bucket Partition-Entropy Objective for Disguised State Resolution
equation_latex: J(k; \mathbf{w}) = \sum_{j=0}^{13} w_j \cdot \left( -p_j (\log_2 c_j - \log_2 n) \right), \quad p_j = \frac{c_j}{n}, \quad n = |\mathcal{S}_{\text{valid}}|
coach_game_impact: Quantifies how an offensive coordinator's early-down play call or pre-snap motion probe k partitions the defense's disguised coverage/pressure state space S_valid into 14 observable feedback buckets (exact leverage match vs partial shell rotation), weighting informative partitions via w_j to maximize pre-snap and post-snap diagnostic entropy before critical 3rd/4th downs.

title: Quadratic Triangular Partition Indexing for Exact-plus-Partial Match Tuples
equation_latex: m(p, q) = \lfloor -0.5 p^2 + 5.5 p + q \rfloor, \quad p \in \{0,1,2,3,4\}, \; p + q \le 4, \; m \in \{0,\dots,13\}
coach_game_impact: Maps a 2D play-outcome alignment tuple (p = exact positional/leverage wins, q = partial scheme/zone displacement wins across 4 primary receiving/blocking tracks) injectively into a 14-state discrete partition index without branching hash tables.

title: Exact-Resolution Terminal Bucket Tie-Breaking (pure13 Singleton Priority) and Iterative State Pruning
equation_latex: k^* = \arg\max_{k} \left( J(k; \mathbf{w}) + \mathbb{I}(|J(k;\mathbf{w}) - J^*| < 10^{-5} \land c_{13}(k) > 0) \right), \quad \mathcal{S}_{\text{valid}}^{(l+1)} = \{ s \in \mathcal{S}_{\text{valid}}^{(l)} : m(k^*, s) = m(k^*, s_{\text{true}}) \}
coach_game_impact: When two play calls yield nearly identical Shannon partition entropy (|Delta J| < 1e-5), the coordinator strictly prefers the play call k that retains non-zero probability of immediate terminal resolution (bucket 13: 4-of-4 exact match / explosive TD beater) and prunes inconsistent defensive shell hypotheses across a 6-play drive horizon.

title: Stagnation-Adaptive Elitist Evolutionary Weight Optimization
coach_game_impact: Models how a coaching staff's tendency weights evolve across weeks: top-6.25% elitism preserves proven scheme weights, top-25% single-point crossover blends complementary tendencies, and stagnation counters (s > 50 or s > 100 stagnant drives/quarters) trigger a 1.2x to 1.8x exploration boost capped at 0.20 to break out of offensive ruts.
